name: concurrency_probe
description: Measures max concurrent entries to its own process(). NOT reentrant -> the host serializes it per instance, so under a parallel dispatch pool max concurrency stays 1.

outputs.name: maxc
outputs.doc: Max workers seen inside process() at once.

outputs.name: overlaps
outputs.doc: Count of process() entries that found another already inside.

exchange.doc: -> { maxc, overlaps, calls } accumulated across the run
